blocks.text: CAINTA, Rizal—Three members of the Strike Lane Elite Bowlers Association, Inc. (Sletba) shone bright when they ruled the finals of the first three divisions in the 28th Sletba Open Championships on Friday. Rica Asuncion kept her composure as she warded off a tough fight put up by four other players to end on top of the Mixed Classified Masters division. Asuncion scored 1,731 pinfalls in the eight-game finals to win the division title, followed by Lyle Yelo Rosales of STAI who had 1,721.
